import subprocess

# Verify all requirements
print("=== Requirement Check ===\n")

# 1. Check commits exist in order
result = subprocess.run(['git', 'log', '--oneline', 'base..HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True)
commits = result.stdout.strip().split('\n')
print(f"Commits on top of base ({len(commits)}):")
for c in commits:
    print(f"  {c}")

# 2. Verify only iterutils.py changed
result = subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', 'base', '--name-only'], capture_output=True, text=True)
changed_files = [f for f in result.stdout.strip().split('\n') if f]
print(f"\nChanged files: {changed_files}")

# 3. Run full test suite
result = subprocess.run(
    ['python', '-m', 'pytest', '-q', '-x', '-p', 'no:cacheprovider', 
     'tests/test_cacheutils.py', 'tests/test_debugutils_trace.py', 
     'tests/test_dictutils.py', 'tests/test_ecoutils.py', 
     'tests/test_fileutils.py', 'tests/test_formatutils.py', 
     'tests/test_funcutils.py', 'tests/test_funcutils_fb.py', 
     'tests/test_funcutils_fb_py3.py', 'tests/test_gcutils.py', 
     'tests/test_ioutils.py', 'tests/test_iterutils.py', 
     'tests/test_jsonutils.py', 'tests/test_listutils.py', 
     'tests/test_mathutils.py', 'tests/test_namedutils.py', 
     'tests/test_queueutils.py', 'tests/test_setutils.py', 
     'tests/test_socketutils.py', 'tests/test_statsutils.py', 
     'tests/test_statsutils_histogram.py', 'tests/test_strutils.py', 
     'tests/test_tableutils.py', 'tests/test_tbutils.py', 
     'tests/test_tbutils_parsed_exc.py', 'tests/test_timeutils.py', 
     'tests/test_typeutils.py', 'tests/test_urlutils.py'],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
print(f"\nTests: exit={result.returncode}")
last_line = result.stdout.strip().split('\n')[-1]
print(f"Result: {last_line}")

# 4. Verify observable behaviors
result = subprocess.run(['python', '-c', '''
from boltons.iterutils import split, partition

# m1 observables
r1 = list(split([1, 2, 3], sep=None, maxsplit=0))
assert r1 == [[1, 2, 3]], f"m1 list fail: {r1}"
r2 = split("abc", sep=None, maxsplit=0)
assert r2 == "abc", f"m1 str fail: {r2}"

# m2 observables
r3 = partition([1, 2, 3], lambda x: x > 1)
assert r3 == ([2, 3], [1]), f"m2 single fail: {r3}"
r4 = partition([1, 2, 3], [lambda x: x > 1, lambda x: x < 3])
assert r4 == ([2], [1], [3]), f"m2 multi fail: {r4}"

print("All observable behaviors verified!")
'''], capture_output=True, text=True)
print(f"\nObservable checks: {result.stdout.strip()}")
if result.stderr:
    print(f"Errors: {result.stderr[:200]}")
